[[Librarian Nichi the Ranger]] is a scholar of the [[Halls of Chokhin]] who is in constant debate with [[Librarian Chitohn]] and can be found in the westernmost corner of the area. He is also an old friend of [[Nicholas the Traveler|Nicholas Sandford]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Holdings of Chokhin}} (inside the [[Halls of Chokhin]])

==Dialogue==
:''"I'm out in the field quite often, so the others have nicknamed me "the Ranger" in jest. Don't tell anyone, but I've grown to like it. I think it suits me."''

==Trivia==
*This [[NPC]] is named after [[User:Nietzsche|Ranger Nietzsche]] of [[Guild:치 The Spearmen 치|치 The Spearmen 치 [치치치치]]] and poster of Guild Wars Online's (one of the [[fansite]] forums for GW) Lore Forum, who is in turn named after the 19th-century philosopher [[w:Nietzsche|Friedrich Nietzsche]] (the German pronunciation of "Nietzsche" sounds like "Nichi").
